# MuseDesk WordPress edition

Open `musedesk-wordpress-blueprint.json` in WordPress Playground. It logs in, writes the self-contained theme and JPEG assets, activates the theme, then seeds native Pages whose content is a Custom HTML block.

The launcher page links to FORM / EARTH and Tideland. This is a front-end demo: no WooCommerce, payment, order, or gateway integration is included.
